messages.subject: Bioc-teaching meeting: Monday, October 12, 2pm CEST
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

just a quick reminder about the bioc-teaching call today at 2pm CEST. The main agenda <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s2QMk5XA-uhBVprAO3ZDk1Yfv1cnUWLp9zdvYq9Feu4/edit?usp=sharing> point today is to formulate the learning objectives for the initial lessons, to simplify later addition and structuring of material. Toby will guide us through the process.
The jitsi link is the same as last time: https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

See you there!
Charlotte & Laurent

messages.subject: Upcoming Bioc-teaching calls
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

just an early heads-up that since the December Bioc-teaching call overlaps with the opening of EuroBioc, we would like to move it one week earlier, that is, to December 7 (same time, 2pm CET). The November call will take place as planned on November 9. Hope this works for everyone.

Thanks,
Charlotte & Laurent
